brief.headline: Bounce Theory hits 208K views; TikTok reach still stuck
brief.summary: Bounce Theory keeps climbing: 208K views and +155 subs in 28 days (up from 127.6K last week), and Ambient Escape is at 42.8K with +130 subs. TikTok is the soft spot: followers sit at 177 and your last posts got 237-367 views, so topic captions alone didn't bring reach back; the shirt-story style, opening on a real moment, still wins. Today's TikTok team picked 'same exam, three guys' off a 309K-views format.
filmToday: TikTok: Epictetus' fix for feeling out of control — Six in ten guys our age feel like they've got barely any control over their life.
TikTok: Who you know is a skill, not luck — Most guys our age think who you know beats how hard you work.
YouTube (Bounce Theory): Soft Body 0% vs 100% Escape — Frame 1: three glowing jelly blobs (0%, 50%, 100% soft) already falling into three stacked spinning rings.
approvals: 16 ideas wait for your review (6 LinkedAI, 3 each TikTok, Growth Architect, AI Opportunities, 1 Repos)

notes: Growth Architect hasn't run in about 6 days, and the R&D Lab and AI Opportunities in about 5; no agent is in error.
The TikTok stats collector is failing (HTTP 500 from TikTok), so those numbers may be stale; YouTube stats are fresh.
New: SmartSub (free offline captions with highlighted keywords) from Repos, and LinkedAI's angle 'free, and it finds the recruiter' while rivals charge $29-50 a month.
